blocks.text: 45 questions: five from each of the 9 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Verb Forms and Participles. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.q: Если у вас болят зубы, то ___ (отправляться) к зубному врачу.
